style.backgroundSystem: light neutral gray studio backdrop #EFEFEF and clean white #FFFFFF alternate across shots, with flat cobalt blue #1E4FA3 and charcoal #3A424C info blocks as accents
style.iconSystem: uniform thin-line circular icons on solid white discs, single accent color #1E4FA3, single stroke weight
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting, front or front-left key, gentle soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent magazine-style menswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of light neutral gray studio background #EFEFEF, clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal info panel #3A424C, dark charcoal text #2D2D2D and one cobalt blue accent #1E4FA3; neutral tone; bright soft diffused studio lighting with soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent white circular thin-line icon discs and flat rectangular info blocks; clean editorial menswear photography mixed with minimal flat infographic elements; stable garment scale and placement with layouts composed edge to edge; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable garment scale across the set, model shots keep the garment fully visible and unobstructed, face never the focus
style.surfaceSystem: seamless matte studio backdrop, no visible tabletop texture
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short bold headlines with letter-spaced magazine micro-labels
